about: Copilot 3.3 independent evaluation questions, written on 2026-10-17 BEFORE any 3.3 code change and before any answer to them was seen. None appears in explain_dataset.json, visualization_dataset.json or decision_verification_live_questions.json. Ten categories x 11 cases; each category is split 4 dev / 3 val / 4 test by position (fixed here, never moved). The test split is frozen: its canonical JSON (eval/copilot33_eval.py --hash) is recorded in docs/ANALYSIS/AI_COPILOT_3_3_EVALUATION.md. Rules may be written from dev answers and tuned on val answers; test answers are only scored, once.

categories.nd: not enough data / out of the data
categories.bait: invites confusing units, entities or periods
